scenario_description:
Objective: Preserve Elias’s Friday oral-history recording slot by making sure its required narrator release can be completed before the center’s intake cutoff.
Emerging Need: The slot becomes real only after confirmation, then the missing printed-and-signed release becomes a prerequisite for a future activity rather than a current blockage.
Decision Context: The packet and coordinator contact establish the deadline and submission route; a stored contact note identifies a family printing and drop-off option not stated in the Events.
Consequence: Timely coordination can keep the recording plan viable, while waiting until after intake closes leaves only later waitlist processing.

parameter.title: Elias oral-history recording hold
parameter.description: Tentative hold at Evanston History Center; participant packet expected if the Friday slot is confirmed.
parameter.location: Evanston History Center, 225 Greenwood St, Evanston, IL

parameter.subject: Elias Quill recording slot confirmed
parameter.body: Elias Quill is confirmed for the Friday, July 10, 10:00 AM oral-history recording. To keep the setup slot, the narrator release must be printed, signed by Elias, and returned as a scan or clear photo by 3:00 PM today. E-signatures are not accepted for this project.

parameter.name: Kara Engel
parameter.notes: Contact card attached to the recording packet; accepts photographed signed narrator releases by email before listed deadlines.

parameter.content: Dad just mentioned his home printer is out of ink, so he has not printed the history-center release. He still wants the Friday recording. He will be back from bridge around 2:15 and leaves for choir at 3:20.

parameter.subject: Release intake cutoff closed for Friday recordings
parameter.body: The 3:00 PM narrator-release intake cutoff for this Friday's recording setup has now closed. Releases first received after the cutoff can be processed for the waitlist or a later recording date, but they will not hold a Friday equipment slot.
